name: unsafe fn downcast_unchecked < T : Any > (self) -> Rc < T , A >
rule: For `Rc<dyn Any, A>::downcast_unchecked::<T>(self)` to be safe, the value contained in `self` must be of type `T`; calling it with an incorrect type is undefined behavior.
api: impl < A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Rc < dyn Any , A > { unsafe fn downcast_unchecked < T : Any > (self) -> alloc::rc::Rc < T , A > }
